name: LP annual meeting — October
summary: Dates, venue, materials, and the Fund V performance narrative for the annual LP meeting.
next_step: The Q2 pacing answer needs a partner's own words before anything else in this project can move.

name: Written pass notes for every declined company
summary: Every pass gets a real reason and, where possible, two intros to funds that fit better. Started as an experiment in April; now standard.
next_step: 31 passes written since April. Nine produced a reply, two produced a referral back. per_theo_brandt is the clearest case — passed on Jul 20, and he has already promised us first look at the next one.

name: Internal AI operations — agent rollout
summary: The seven agents behind this system: what they own, what they are allowed to do without a human, and what has to escalate. Rolled out one module at a time rather than all at once.
next_step: Six of seven agents are live. The seventh, agt_diligence, still runs with a human reading every brief before it is shown — that gate comes off only once thirty briefs have been checked for fabricated numbers.

needs_decision.question: Should the diligence agent's briefs be visible before a human has read them?
needs_decision.why: The failure mode is not a badly written brief, it is a confidently wrong number that gets repeated in a partner meeting. Twenty-two briefs have been checked so far and two contained a metric that could not be traced to a source. Two out of twenty-two is too high to remove the gate.
needs_decision.cost_of_delay: None urgent. The gate costs about fifteen minutes per brief and it is currently buying more than it costs.

name: Q4 speaking and events
summary: Which of eleven Q4 speaking invitations to accept, and protecting the weeks around them.
next_step: Eleven invitations, two answered. The November block is the binding constraint — per_lassiter's summit wants a full day on Nov 12 and there are already two travel commitments that week.

name: Portfolio founder dinner — Philadelphia, September
summary: Twenty-four founders, one evening, no programming. The point is that they meet each other rather than us.
next_step: Venue booked, 19 of 24 confirmed. per_amara_king and per_jonah_reyes have not replied — both are mid-raise, so a personal note works better than another calendar invite.
